resolved_findings.title: Reject decoded Windows UNC paths before filesystem resolution
resolved_findings.supported_reason: The original netloc-only guard accepted %5C%5Cserver%5Cshare%5Cx as a local reference. A no-network reproduction with Path.resolve replaced by identity returned file://server/share/x, after which inspect_source would stat/read a network target. This contradicted the documented unsupported-network-file boundary.
resolved_findings.repair_evidence: The final code checks decoded slash-normalized paths before Path.resolve. test_encoded_unc_file_links_are_rejected_before_filesystem_access patches Path.resolve with a denial sentinel and rejects raw and encoded UNC targets.
resolved_findings.verification: Final standard-library and ReportLab suites pass the regression; no network target was contacted.

resolved_findings.title: Bind internal bookmarks to logical pages during deferred serialization
resolved_findings.supported_reason: Original CountedCanvas.showPage deferred the base showPage call. ReportLab 4.4.9 Canvas._startPage increments only canvas._pageNumber; PDFDocument.pageCounter increments in addPage during base showPage. Paragraph anchors call bookmarkPage and thisPageRef, so headings laid out after page one would otherwise retain Page1 references.
resolved_findings.repair_evidence: logical_bookmark temporarily sets the PDFDocument counter to the logical canvas page number and restores the counter in finally; CountedCanvas.bookmarkPage delegates to it.
resolved_findings.verification: test_internal_bookmark_uses_logical_page_before_serialization passes with logical page3, document counter1 before/after, destination Page3 and an empty never-saved BytesIO buffer.
